scope: Shared frontend. OS detection is for UI hints only; Rust validates actual file access.
changes: Backend-confirmed Windows drive and extended paths pass recovery and archive checks without bypassing active-work guards
File URIs encode literal percent, hash, spaces and Unicode; failed conversion preserves draft and attachments
Windows separators are handled in file titles
Ctrl shortcuts and approval hints share the Mac UI implementation; focus/composition guards remain

checks.independentReview: quality reviewed URI conversion and complete-before-mutation Composer protection without a confirmed blocker

limits: Synthetic production components/controllers; no Windows WebView2 execution
Entire Windows application compile/run remains pending native integration
Foreign-host file URIs are not automatically read; explicitly selected UNC still requires backend support
